mapper.select: SELECT config_key, config_value, remark, update_time FROM sys_config WHERE config_key LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') ORDER BY config_key ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_config (config_key, config_value, remark, update_time) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{remark}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE config_value = VALUES(config_value), remark = VALUES(remark), update_time = NOW()
